name: Tile CastleVania
author: Chris766X
description:
WASD/←↑→↓  :  To Move                                                                                       Space                 :  To Jump                                                                                        Ctrl                     :  To  Fire Arrows                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                   
 Navigate through the 4 Levels to get a score as high as possible with only 3 lives.                                                                                                            
 Burning through all lives means game over.                                                   Get a higher score then the previous player and u will see your name displayed
